journey.name: Change and persist focus duration
journey.description: Use a dedicated test profile with freshly provisioned app data, default four-cycle settings and automatic starts disabled; do not reset or clear a user's personal app data. Save a quick duration preset, verify it persists, and confirm that changing duration does not modify an active session. Cancelling the sequence then prepares a new focus with the updated duration.

actions.action: Verify that 'Foco' and the timer value '25:00' are visible
Verify that the selected duration is '30 min'
Verify that the selected duration is still '30 min'
If the 'Receber avisos de sessão' dialog appears, tap 'Permitir'
If Android asks for notification permission, allow notifications
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Verify that the selected duration is '31 min'
Verify that the paused remaining time is unchanged
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro' inside the confirmation dialog
Verify that 'Foco', '31:00', 'Ciclo 1 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
